props.title: Lisbon in December
props.subtitle: Five days, 14 to 19 December. Planning notes for the group.

props.text:
Mild and wet: **12 to 16 °C**, rain on about half the days. Trams and the old town are better in the rain than they sound; the **Christmas lights** are on from early December.

Flights are the cost that moves, so book those first.

items.title: Getting around
items.text:
Buy a **Viva Viagem** card at any metro station and load it with zapping credit; it works on metro, trams and buses.

The hills are steep: comfortable shoes matter more than a map.

items.title: Eating
items.text:
Lunch menus (*prato do dia*) are the cheapest good meal, usually €10 to €13 with a drink.

- Book dinner on Friday and Saturday
- Many kitchens close between 15:00 and 19:00

props.title: Baixa flat
props.text: It is cheaper, the airport link is easier, and a lift matters with four suitcases. The loft wins only if quiet is the priority.

docker ps --filter name=game

props.title: Save first
props.text: A restart during a save can lose the last few minutes of progress.
docker restart game
Wait about **40 seconds** for the world to load.
Open the game's page and use the restart control. It saves first, then restarts.

items.title: It still will not come up
items.text:
Check free disk space, then the last lines of the log:

```
df -h /data
```

A full disk is the usual cause.

items.title: Rolling back a save
items.text: Backups are kept daily for a week. Restore the newest one from **before** the problem began.
